title: ADR-001: Modular monolith plus worker
summary: docs/adr/ADR-001-modular-monolith.md · 原文保留历史日期；先学主课程，需要核查时再读。
html:
Status: Accepted in M0.

AgentHub remains one repository and one business deployment with API, worker and web processes. This keeps cross-module semantics testable while allowing durable/background work to run outside the request process. Multiple containers do not imply microservices.
